notes:
VERIFY BY HAND for the body text against a machine with sessions; the shape assertions are the gate.

2026-11-03 (iter-1706, MEASURED, two rounds of correction): the ORIGINAL asserts pinned strings that no longer exist in this tree, both written on earlier evidence rather than re-measured. 'Loading sessions' is the hub's INTERIM banner (session_hub/render.rs:560) and it paints only while state.loading is true; on a fixture with no sessions the spawn_blocking scan settles before the first painted frame, so the frame is the EMPTY state instead ('No sessions to show.', :571 and :925). 'this branch' was the /branch variant's audit-R1 needle and it is gone: the hub's title block was rebuilt from the single-line ' Sessions [<filter>] ' at :245 into a bordered 'Sessions 0 rows / s cycle / Group: all' pane, across 22 commits since this golden, none of them mine. 'Esc closes' (the footer at :182) survives at 120x40 but is CLIPPED at 80x24, so it is size-dependent and belongs in no shared assert.

What the three variants pin now is only what is common to every size, every load state, and both doors into the pane: 'Sessions' plus the two state assertions. The goldens are NOT re-proved here: this surface is a peer's in-flight rebuild and overwriting their session-hub.txt/style.txt baseline would destroy WIP that is not mine. The scenario runs green against the CURRENT render once the shape assertions match reality; the baseline files stay with their owner.
